seedlod.config.title: Seed LOD
seedlod.config.enabled.tooltip: Fill Voxy's distant terrain from the world seed. Off leaves Voxy with only the chunks you've loaded.
seedlod.config.threads.tooltip: Generation threads. Auto uses half your cores minus one; they run at low priority.
seedlod.config.detail.tooltip: 100% generates the detail Voxy draws at your window size and field of view. Lower fills faster and is coarser up close.
seedlod.config.finestLevel.tooltip: Smallest voxel generated. 1 block matches real chunks up close; larger skips the finest levels for speed.
